message:
## Overview

This PR removes the `_TEST_` prefix from PMM High Availability environment variables to officially promote them from preview/test status to production-ready supported variables.

## Changes

All `PMM_TEST_HA_*` environment variables have been renamed to `PMM_HA_*` across the codebase:

- `PMM_TEST_HA_ENABLE` → `PMM_HA_ENABLE`
- `PMM_TEST_HA_BOOTSTRAP` → `PMM_HA_BOOTSTRAP`
- `PMM_TEST_HA_NODE_ID` → `PMM_HA_NODE_ID`
- `PMM_TEST_HA_ADVERTISE_ADDRESS` → `PMM_HA_ADVERTISE_ADDRESS`
- `PMM_TEST_HA_PEERS` → `PMM_HA_PEERS`
- `PMM_TEST_HA_RAFT_PORT` → `PMM_HA_RAFT_PORT`
- `PMM_TEST_HA_GOSSIP_PORT` → `PMM_HA_GOSSIP_PORT`
- `PMM_TEST_HA_GRAFANA_GOSSIP_PORT` → `PMM_HA_GRAFANA_GOSSIP_PORT`

## Files Modified

- **managed/cmd/pmm-managed/main.go** - Updated environment variable bindings for HA flags
- **docker-compose.ha.yml** - Updated all HA environment variables across active and passive PMM server instances
- **documentation/docs/install-pmm/HA.md** - Updated all HA deployment examples and configuration
- **documentation/docs/install-pmm/install-pmm-server/deployment-options/docker/preview_env_var.md** - Updated variable documentation
- **managed/services/telemetry/config.default.yml** - Updated telemetry tracking configuration
- **docs/process/best_practices.md** - Updated environment variable naming convention example

## Impact

Users currently using `PMM_TEST_HA_*` variables will need to update their configurations to use the new `PMM_HA_*` variable names. This change reflects the maturity and official support status of the HA feature in PMM.

## Testing

- ✅ Go code compiles successfully
- ✅ All references to old variable names removed from codebase
- ✅ Documentation updated to reflect new variable names
